maddeler.e: ذُو • (ḏū) m (dual ذَوَا (ḏawā, oblique ذَوَيْ (ḏaway)), plural ذَوُو (ḏawū, oblique ذَوِي (ḏawī)) or أُولُو (ʔulū, oblique أُولِي (ʔulī)), feminine ذَات (ḏāt))
maddeler.t: Equivalent to the second element in هٰذَا (hāḏā, “this”) and the first element in ذٰلِكَ (ḏālika, “that”); compare also their plural forms. Related to Aramaic דִּי (dī) and Hebrew זֶה (ze).
